name: Locked In For The Win
source:
Your star gymnast can't seem to concentrate on his competition. That's when you decide it's time to lock your jock's cock.

To ensure your star athlete doesn't distract themselves from their game, you decide it's time for you to introduce them to chastity, with the hope of improving their performance.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3963290/Locked_In_For_The_Win/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你手下的明星體操選手似乎總沒法專心比賽。於是你決定，是時候鎖住這位健將的老二了。

為了不讓這位明星選手在賽場上分心，你決定帶他嘗試貞操鎖，希望這樣能提升他的表現。
